messages:
talia (finance): Quick heads-up: launching Dynamic Account Smoothing (DAS) and an updated credit redemption window. This aims to reduce surprise overages for bursty tenants and make invoice lines easier to parse. Effective 2025-12-01 for new signups; existing customers get a 45-day migration window.

jo (product): Short summary for customer comms? What's changing in plain terms?

talia (finance): Two changes: 1) Rate smoothing: we replace a rigid monthly soft-quota with a per-route burst pool that absorbs short spikes and redistributes unused burst to routes with similar profiles. 2) Credits: trial and promotional credits move to a 90-day rolling redeem period (same total value). We'll include examples.

ravi (eng-runtime): Impl notes: enforcement lives in the router and billing-export pipeline. New export fields: `smoothing_pool_id`, `burst_consumed_tokens`, `burst_adjustment_type` (values: spilled|redistributed). We'll add a console metric `smoothing_pool_health`. No change to tokenization or model accounting. Rollout plan: canary Nov 20, region rollouts through Nov 27, GA Dec 1.

ciara (support): Need: FAQ, canned responses for overage alerts, and example invoices showing how redistributed bursts appear. Also quick steps for Dedicated & Private customers to opt out.

contracts-bot: Legal note: We'll surface an amendment stating redistribution is a billing presentation/aggregation feature and not a price increase. Add a 45-day opt-out clause for active enterprise contracts.

deploy-bot: Internal customer email scheduled 2025-11-14 17:00 UTC. Console teaser banner scheduled 2025-11-15.

jo (product): Example invoice snippet for the new summarized view (this is illustrative):
```
INVOICE SUMMARY
- route: embeddings/search             | usage: 45,210 | burst_used: 2,100 | adjustment: redistributed | line_total: $412.34
- route: chat/multiturn               | usage: 12,004 | burst_used: 0     | adjustment: none         | line_total: $120.12
SUBTOTAL: $532.46
DAS CREDIT APPLIED: -$10.00
TOTAL: $522.46
```

ciara (support): Also: alerts will say "Near burst buffer" instead of the old "soft quota hit". Please send example webhook payloads for notification consumers.

ravi (eng-runtime): Webhook payload will include `burst_window_start`, `burst_remaining_pct`, and `pool_id`. We'll post schema in the billing API docs. Dedicated customers: toggle in Console to disable DAS. Private: config flag in the deployment manifest.

talia (finance): Customer-facing messaging: emphasize fewer false overages and longer time to use credits. We'll call it "smoothing" and avoid technical terms in the headline. Internally, finance will run a 4-week cost-impact analysis during the pilot and publish results.

jo (product): Marketing: one-pager and blog draft requested by 2025-11-06. Support & Sales: training session scheduled 2025-11-17.

ciara (support): I'll assemble top-20 Qs and a binder of example invoices for CS by Nov 10.

talia (finance): Thanks everyone. DM me if you need specific customer lists for the pilot cohort. :sparkles:
